relations.statement: Tetrahedral labels violating admissibility give zero vertex amplitude, a finite analogue of the trivalent admissibility constraint on intertwiners.

lemmas.statement: The Hilbert-lift completion of a pre-Hilbert space is a complete inner product space. This is the only existing completion tool, and it does not supply SU(2) Haar measure or Peter-Weyl.

near_misses.claim: The U(1) circle completion (QuadSqrt5) already gives the SU(2) Haar measure and Peter-Weyl decomposition.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: U(1) is abelian with a 1-dimensional irrep structure; SU(2) is non-abelian, with irreps of dimension 2j+1 and Clebsch-Gordan intertwiners. The circle completion is also still an open gap.

near_misses.claim: q-deformed cyclotomic vertex amplitudes constitute the Haar-measure Hilbert space of spin networks.
near_misses.rejecting_invariant: The amplitudes are finite Cyclo12 values with no integration over a compact group, so they carry no Haar measure.

open_obligations: SU(2) Haar measure not available in the repository
Peter-Weyl decomposition for SU(2) not formalized
Spin network graph/intertwiner state space not defined
Link between Cyclo12 vertex amplitude and the SU(2) Hilbert space is unproven
Circle gap FQ-GAP-U1-CIRCLE is still open
